remarks: This luxurious high-rise penthouse in the heart of South Norwalk epitomizes modern sophistication and urban elegance. Perched at the top of a sleek, contemporary building, this residence has sweeping panoramic views of the city and Long Island Sound through floor-to-ceiling windows. Boasting a modern open floor plan, the expansive living and dining areas are bathed in natural light, perfect for entertaining or quiet relaxation. The gourmet kitchen features high-end stainless-steel appliances, sleek quartz countertops, and custom cabinetry. The primary suite is serene, complete with a spa-inspired ensuite bathroom and walk-in closet. Additional bedrooms are spacious and versatile, ideal for guests or home offices. Tons of upgrades including a Control 4 Audio system and, motorized roller shades. Located in the vibrant SONO district, you're steps away from the South Norwalk metro, fine dining, shopping, and entertainment. This penthouse combines elegance, convenience, and lifestyle in one exceptional package. There is nothing to do but move right in.
